# Stand Firm in the Fire
## Scripture
"Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain." – 1 Corinthians 15:58
## Reflection
Men, we live in a world that rewards the flashy and the fast. But the kingdom of God is built on something sturdier: steadfastness. Paul writes to a church surrounded by pressure and tells them to be immovable—like a rock in a rushing river. That word isn't passive. It's the stance of a soldier holding the line when everything around him says retreat.

Think about your week. Where are you tempted to drift? Maybe it's the early morning you keep hitting snooze on, the prayer life you've let go quiet, or the integrity you're tempted to compromise when no one's watching. Steadfastness is built in those small, unglamorous moments—showing up when it's hard, keeping your word, doing the work even when no one claps.

And here's the promise that fuels it: your labor in the Lord is *not in vain*. No faithful pushup of obedience goes unseen by your Father. He is counting, He is strengthening, and He is faithful. So plant your feet today. Hold the line. Abound in the work—because the One who called you is immovable, and He's making you like Himself.
## Daily Challenge
Do 20 pushups, holding the plank position an extra 10 seconds at the top of the last rep—thanking God that He makes you steadfast. Then text one brother and ask him to hold the line with you this week.
